    Shifted projective duality for two-term complexes #

    source
    def EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.shiftedDual {R : Type u} [Ring R] (P : TwoTerm R) :
    TwoTerm Rᵐᵒᵖ

    Dualize the projective terms and reverse degrees to obtain another two-term complex.

      theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_shiftedDual_iso {R : Type u} [Ring R] (Q : TwoTerm Rᵐᵒᵖ) :
